header.name: Statistical Inference
header.description: The course introduces the theoretical concepts and derivations of parametric and non parametric statistical inference. It also gives a brief introduction to building statistical linear models and analyze them. The course includes estimation, hypothesis testing, confidence interval and an introduction to Linear Regression and ANOVA. The students will learn derivations, simulations, and analysis of the real data.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students will learn the concepts of finding best statistic and estimation. They will be able to apply commonly used parametric estimation techniques.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to test the hypothesis and construct confidence intervals for a known probability distributions.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students will also be able to test the hypothesis when the distribution is unknown and when the data is categorical.

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to build codes in R (or equivalent) to perform inferences and build simple statistical models

outcomes.label: CO5
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to build and analyze simple statistical models. They will be able to apply the methods on real life data.

lecture_topics: Principles of data reduction: Sufficient, minimal and complete statistics
Method of Point Estimation: Moments, maximum likelihood, expectation minimization
Methods of evaluating estimators: mean squared error, unbiasedness, sufficiency, consistency
Hypothesis Testing : Likelihood ratio test, invariant tests
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Tutorial 3 : Building hypothesis and test for real life examples. Calculate their error probabilities and find power.

lecture_topics: Interval Estimation : inverting a test statistics, pivotal quantities, invariant intervals
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Tutorial 4 : Theoretical on interval estimation for real life examples.

lecture_topics: Random sample: sum of random sample, sample mean and properties of sample mean and variance
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Tutorial 5, 6: Building hypothesis and test for real life examples.
Tutorial 7, 8: One assignment on Regression and another on ANOVA. It will involve building models and analyzing the real life data.

resources.title: Introduction to Mathematical Statistics, by Robert V. Hogg and Allen T Craig
An Introduction to Probability and Statistics by Vijay K. Rohatgi and A.K. Md Ehsanes Saleh (2nd Edition)
Statistical Inference, Second edition, by George Casella and Roger L Berger
